title: WorldCast: Exploring Intelligent Visual Generation in World State Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.20731v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Humans interpret multimodal observations of the world and forecast how it will evolve. Recent multimodal generative systems have demonstrated similar capabilities: they can integrate multimodal context and synthesize visual outputs that depict changes in the world. To characterize this emerging trajectory, we organize model capabilities into a four-level hierarchy and discover that higher-level tasks remain relatively underexplored despite model progress. To bridge this gap, we explore model performance on multi-step world state prediction, a high-level task that requires models to forecast successive future world states from multimodal observations and diverse references. Such a task requires models to possess entangled understanding and generation capabilities, as well as extensive world knowledge to translate human action sequences, physical transformations, and abstract visual reasoning into coherent visual outputs. translated_title: WorldCast：探索世界状态预测中的智能视觉生成
translated_abstract: 人类通过解读世界的多模态观测来预测世界将如何演变。近期的多模态生成系统已展现出类似的能力：它们能够整合多模态上下文，并合成描绘世界变化的视觉输出。为了刻画这一新兴发展趋势，我们将模型能力组织为四个层级，并发现尽管模型不断进步，更高层级的任务仍相对缺乏探索。为弥补这一空白，我们探索了模型在多步世界状态预测上的表现，这是一项高级任务，要求模型根据多模态观测和多样化的参考来预测连续的未来世界状态。这样的任务要求模型具备深度耦合的理解与生成能力，以及广博的世界知识，从而能够将人类动作序列、物理变换和抽象视觉推理转化为连贯的视觉输出。我们引入了Wo……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出WorldCast，将多步世界状态预测作为一项高级视觉生成任务加以探索，要求模型结合理解与生成能力及世界知识，从多模态观测和参考中预测连续的未来世界状态。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes WorldCast, exploring multi-step world state prediction as a high-level visual generation task in which models must combine understanding and generation capabilities with extensive world knowledge to forecast successive future world states from multimodal observations and diverse references.
